slides.headline: VPS Price Sales Tax
slides.caption: The advertised price is not the price you pay. At all three providers we checked, the number on the pricing page is pre-tax.

slides.headline: What gets added at checkout
bullets: DigitalOcean adds state and city sales tax on top of the advertised figure
OVHcloud's US page discloses tax only through an HTML class named tax-excluded-price
Hetzner prints excl. VAT next to every monthly and hourly price
slides.caption: DigitalOcean adds state sales tax. OVHcloud's US page discloses tax only through an HTML class name. Hetzner prints excl. VAT next to every price.

slides.headline: About two dozen US states and cities
slides.caption: DigitalOcean publishes the rates: about two dozen states and cities, from one percent in Connecticut to eleven and a half percent in Puerto Rico.

slides.headline: What a $24 plan costs after tax
slides.caption: A twenty-four dollar plan becomes twenty-five fifty in Texas, twenty-five fifty-six in Washington state, and twenty-six seventy-six in Puerto Rico.

slides.headline: 5.3x becomes 5.90x
slides.caption: Against OVHcloud's four fifty-four, the pre-tax gap is five point three times. After DigitalOcean's tax alone it becomes five point nine times.

slides.headline: Every figure traces to a provider page
slides.caption: Every figure, its source, and the formula behind each ratio is on the page: serverbudget dot com, slash vps price sales tax.
